jobs.description:
Position Description

The Opportunity

Toronto Financial Services is entering its next phase of growth. Artificial intelligence is changing how clients operate, Global Capability Centres are reshaping delivery models, and market disruption is accelerating. Clients increasingly look to CGI for strategic business outcomes.

CGI is investing in a leader who can accelerate growth, strengthen executive relationships, expand consulting-led engagements, and position CGI as a partner for business and technology transformation.

You will bring together CGI’s capabilities—including Business Consulting, Systems Integration, Managed Services, AI-enabled services, reusable IP, and strategic partnerships—to solve clients’ business challenges and build long-term relationships.

As leader of one of CGI Canada’s largest Financial Services businesses, you will have full accountability for growth, profitability, client relationships, delivery excellence, and leadership development. You will grow the business by connecting clients with the full breadth of CGI’s capabilities.

Your future duties and responsibilities

What you’ll deliver

Accelerate growth

Grow organically and win new business across Managed Services, Systems Integration, Business Consulting, and IP—in existing client ecosystems and new markets.

Elevate Business Consulting

Make Business Consulting a primary driver of transformational engagements. Build consulting-led opportunities that create lasting strategic partnerships and deepen CGI’s influence within client organizations.

Drive profitable growth

Improve profitability through disciplined portfolio management, innovative commercial models, and operational excellence. Expand higher-value, outcome-based engagements and strengthen contribution margins.

Build AI into the business

Use AI to improve productivity, delivery, and client outcomes. Develop new revenue opportunities through AI-enabled services.

Build a high-performing culture

Develop a strong leadership bench and attract exceptional talent. Simplify the operating model to support growth without proportional increases in headcount, while fostering energy, collaboration, and belonging.

Create new demand

Raise CGI’s profile with clients, alliance partners, and the market through measurable client outcomes, strategic relationships, and thought leadership.

Grow through partnerships

Work with hyperscaler and technology partners, and pursue client co-innovation, to extend CGI’s reach and create new growth opportunities.

Who you’ll work with

Report to the BU Leader, Financial Services.
Lead Vice Presidents and Directors across Consulting, Delivery, and Client Management.
Partner with enterprise leaders in Business Consulting, IP and AI, HR, Marketing, and Operations.
Build strategic relationships with alliance partners and industry leaders.
Engage directly with C-suite executives across the client base.

The operating code

Own it: Address problems early with accountability and ownership.
Move at the speed of the opportunity: Make timely decisions and respond to clients’ needs.
Bring ideas before they’re asked for: Shape the agenda and anticipate opportunities.
Make AI non-negotiable: Build AI fluency across the leadership team and the business.
Protect the standard: Maintain quality, delivery excellence, and client trust.
Say the hard thing early: Lead with transparency and clarity.
Prove it with numbers: Measure success through outcomes and business impact.
Make noise about what works: Recognize success and share practices that can benefit the broader business.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

What you’ve done before:

Built or scaled a consulting, technology, or managed services business with full P&L accountability, growing revenue and margin together.
Driven organic growth and new client acquisition across multiple service lines.
Led executive-level client relationships and secured large, strategic engagements, including opportunities developed before formal procurement.
Shifted staff augmentation or time-and-materials engagements to outcome-based commercial models.
Built leadership teams and succession plans, and raised market visibility through analyst relations, media engagement, and industry recognition.
Led AI adoption across a leadership team and the business.
Earned a bachelor’s degree or gained equivalent experience. An MBA is an asset.

What success looks likeThree years from now:

Revenue growth has outpaced the market.
Business Consulting represents a larger share of the business.
AI-enabled services generate meaningful revenue.
Contribution margins have improved.
Clients engage CGI earlier and more strategically.
Leaders have advanced into broader enterprise roles.
Capabilities developed within the sector are being applied across Toronto Financial Services

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

How We Work

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

Job Overview

Within Professional Services, you'll lead the Solutions Architecture team through a fundamental change: from a technical intake team that passes integration work to third parties to a team that designs and builds the integrations we choose to own on Workato. You'll decide which integrations are strategic to own and which third parties can deliver faster, and you'll balance capacity across Coursera and Udemy technical work. You'll lay a foundation to build from, so that integrations are productized and reusable rather than one-offs, and you'll upskill the team to design, build, and test the way an engineering team does. You'll also take ownership of integrations built by third parties for both Coursera and Udemy, and decide what, if anything, to migrate in house. This is a highly operational role. You'll redesign how the team works with Product, Partnerships, Presales, and Customer Support, define workflows that are not yet defined, and build the delivery discipline, capacity model, and metrics that make the function run like a well-oiled machine. You'll report to the Senior Director of Professional Services and partner closely with the Director of AI Innovation to streamline how the team works.

Responsibilities

Lead the shift from a technical intake team that routes work to third parties to a team that builds the integrations we choose to own, and set the criteria, service levels, and pricing for what we own versus what third parties deliver.
Own the integration roadmap and prioritization with Product, Partnerships, Engineering, and Support, and make capacity and load-balancing tradeoffs across Coursera and Udemy technical work.
Establish the Workato foundation and productize what we can, with shared standards and reusable components, and a custom layer on top that is easy to adapt. Build reuse into design review.
Take ownership of the inherited integrations, six years of third-party work on the Coursera platform and a handful on Udemy. Document them, decide what, if anything, to migrate, retire, or keep, and steward the code and its environment.
Hire and upskill the team to design, build, and test like engineers, aligned with Coursera Engineering's standards. Use AI-assisted development deliberately so the team builds fundamentals first, and manage token usage.
Redesign how the team works, including Jira, intake, and workflows with Product, Partnerships, Presales, and Support, and train Support to deflect development-related tickets.
Own the run and support model for what we build, including monitoring, maintenance, versioning, and service levels. Meet security, contractual, and data privacy standards, and serve as the senior escalation point for high-risk issues.
Partner with Presales on early scoping and own the technical handoff from Sales into delivery. Work with the Director of AI Innovation and Solutions on the pilot-to-PS transition review and on streamlining the team's work.
Run utilization and project tracking, manage the technical service catalog, pricing, SOWs, and margin, and build metrics that show impact on deal size, time to production, retention, and quality.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience in solutions architecture, technical professional services, or integration consulting, with a strong focus on API integrations (REST, SOAP, GraphQL) and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Proven experience leading and developing technical teams, ideally globally distributed, and running a technical delivery function, including capacity planning, utilization, and cross-team workflows.
Experience building reusable, productized integrations on an iPaaS platform and designing for reuse across customers.
Experience applying engineering standards (SDLC, design and code review, testing) to integration delivery, and coaching a team to adopt them.
Experience taking over third-party-built or inherited code and making build, buy, partner, and migrate decisions, including managing third-party partners.
Direct experience in pre-sales activity for technical services, including discovery, scoping, and SOW creation.
Strong communicator with stakeholders from engineers to executives. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Workato, or a comparable iPaaS platform such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Jitterbit, or Tray.io.
Integration experience with SSO, ERP, HRIS, and LMS/LXP systems.
Experience integrating teams, codebases, or service portfolios through a merger or acquisition.
Proficiency in data analytics and SQL.

Compensation

Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring base salary range for this role in Canada is $175,000 - $218,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à être plus efficaces et plus durables, et chaque personne ici contribue à cet impact. This Director role is a strategic transformation position within ABB's NEMA International division, reporting to the EVP International Sales. The role is pivotal in building a scalable international business platform by strengthening alignment across Regions, Business Lines and functions, removing structural barriers to growth and driving implementation of the Stabilize-Optimize-Scale roadmap. The successful candidate will drive business transformation across regions while building scalable operating foundations, combining expertise in strategy execution, operating-model redesign, business process management, change leadership, and executive influence within a complex global matrix.

The role is contributing to the Motion NEMA Motors division globally.

Lead resolution of systemic barriers at the interfaces between International Sales, Global Operations, IT, Finance, HR and other supporting functions, converting fragmented issues into prioritized root-cause initiatives with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Serve as custodian of the NEMA International target operating model, ensuring organizational accountabilities, governance, processes, technology and capabilities evolve coherently to enable profitable international growth, from stabilization through optimization and scale, while designing the organization for future growth and acquisitions.
Lead an executive-level International Transformation Office that manages the transformation portfolio, governance cadence, dependency view and risk escalation, mobilizing cross-functional workstreams and intervening to resolve ownership gaps, resource constraints or delayed decisions.
Lead adoption of the new international organization and ways of working through change leadership, stakeholder engagement and capability building, while establishing a continuous improvement framework that connects frontline issues to structural business improvements and embeds continuous improvement into leadership accountability.

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in business transformation, strategy execution, operating-model design, commercial excellence, enterprise program leadership or management consulting.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Information Systems or a related discipline.
Experience in an internal strategy, transformation, business excellence or consulting role.
